# Adherence SOP

This SOP outlines how to check and manage participant task adherence.

## Checking adherence

* `make_adherence.R` is automated to run daily. It writes out an adherence snapshot for all particiapants to `S:/optimize/data_admin/adherence`. 
* participant-level adherence can be spot-checked via `chk_adherence.qmd`, located under `staff_scripts`
